topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: They say change is the only constant, but it’s a bitter pill when your home becomes the whipping boy for market forces. The building, once a sanctuary, is now a canvas for speculation. Condos—slick, impersonal, a$$$embles of glass and steel. The walls that whispered with the echoes of our lives will soon be painted over, renamed, repurposed. I find myself walking the halls, memorizing the creaks and groans, the very breath of this place. Neighbors, once strangers, now share a bond forged in the crucible of uncertainty. We discuss our fates, our futures, not just as tenants but as a community. It’s a strange sort of kinship, born from the ashes of the old order.
